name: critical-mass
description: Multi-exchange BTC accumulation engine with celestial position management

scripts.start: pm2 stop ecosystem.config.cjs >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; pm2 delete ecosystem.config.cjs >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; for p in 5563 5564 5565 5566 5567; do if lsof -i :$p -sTCP:LISTEN -t >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "Error: required port $p remains occupied after stopping Critical Mass PM2 processes." >&2; exit 1; fi; done; pm2 start ecosystem.config.cjs && pm2 save
scripts.dev:ui: cd admin && VITE_PORT=5564 VITE_API_PORT=5563 npm run dev
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd admin && npm install

author: Adam Eivy (@antic|@atomantic)
